title: MDMC (disambiguation)

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
MDMC may refer to:

* EDMA, a psychedelic substance of the amphetamine class first synthesized by Alexander Shulgin.
* Methylone, a novel stimulant-entactogen substance of the cathinone class.
wikitext:
'''MDMC''' may refer to:

* '''[[EDMA]]''', a [[Psychedelic|psychedelic substance]] of the [[Substituted_amphetamine|amphetamine class]] first synthesized by [[Alexander Shulgin]].
* '''[[Methylone]]''', a [[Research chemicals|novel]] [[Stimulant|stimulant]]-[[Entactogen|entactogen]] substance of the [[Cathinone|cathinone class]].
